pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with softened, non-linear edge gradients. Geometric shapes vary from sub-rectilinear to amorphous with rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous interstitial network of light-toned pelage. Pathways exhibit high pixel thickness relative to patch size, forming a topological graph with prominent tri-valent and tetra-valent junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal-cranial line, representing a short, upright mane structure.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized clusters of hyper-pigmented, raised textural disruptions are visible on the upper shoulder and lower neck within the dorsal-most patches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, dark, nodular lesions approximately 1-3cm in diameter are distributed across the mid-flank and posterior regions, suggesting parasitic or skin-related pathology.
